name: smwmusic-crash-team-racing-oxide-station
title: Crash Team Racing - Oxide Station
description:
A fast paced and somewhat tense space theme that plays in Oxide Station, a space themed track and the track where the final boss race against Nitros Oxide takes place.

Update (Summer 2024): Added the drum intro from Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled

You can define in the .txt file if you want to use the normal version or the pre-console version which is slightly longer.
